name: edit
description: Performs exact string replacement in a file. file_path must be absolute. The file must have been read in this session before editing — the impl rejects edits otherwise. By default `old_string` must occur exactly once; set `replace_all: true` to replace every occurrence (useful for renaming a symbol). Preserve exact indentation. Fails when `old_string` is not unique unless replace_all is true. `new_string` must differ from `old_string`.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: Required absolute path to the file to modify.

inputs.name: old_string
inputs.description: Required exact text to replace. Must be unique in the file unless replace_all=true. Preserve the exact whitespace/indentation as it appears in the file.

inputs.name: new_string
inputs.description: Required replacement text. Must differ from old_string.

inputs.name: replace_all
inputs.description: If true, replace every occurrence of old_string. Default false (replace exactly one match).
